title: Databases with low backup success rate
description: For each database_name with at least three backups, calculate success_pct as 100.0 * successful / total rounded to one decimal place. Only status = success counts as successful. Keep databases with success_pct below 80.0. Return exactly three columns: database_name, backup_count, success_pct. Sort by success_pct ASC, then database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name, COUNT(*) AS backup_count
FROM backups
GROUP BY database_name
solution_explanation: The minimum sample size and quality threshold are both enforced in HAVING.
